title: The Slow Snail
lines: Tim met a snail on the wet road.
Rain fell all day and made a mess.
The snail crept up to reach a green leaf.
It went so slow that Tim fell asleep.
A gray crow came to peck at it.
Tim woke up and gave a big yell.
The crow left, and the snail got its leaf.

questions.ask: What was the snail trying to reach?
questions.listenFor: A green leaf. It is right in the story - have them point to the line.

questions.ask: How did Tim keep the crow from the snail?
questions.listenFor: He woke up and yelled. Listen for both parts, not just the yell.

questions.ask: Do you think Tim did the right thing? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Some children feel bad for the crow.
